Generate a colour-blind-friendly palette

LaMaColors.Rd

Generate a colour-blind-friendly palette

Usage

LaMaColors(ncolors)

Arguments

ncolors

Number of colours to return; at most 10

Value

A colour palette of length ncolors

Examples

cb <- LaMaColors(3)
